title: FAQs
description: Answers about XionTech services, collaboration across time zones, data security, and how we measure value.

head.b: Talk to us about any question.

aside: Ten answers about how we work. Something else? Call <call>{{phone}}</call>.

services.a: XionTech offers digital product engineering, digital insights and analytics, product co-creation, and staffing services. These services use emerging technologies like AI/ML and generative AI. XionTech focuses on industries such as EdTech, healthcare, logistics, and private equity.

collaboration.q: How does XionTech collaborate across time zones?
collaboration.a: Through extensive time zone coverage that gives overlap between regions, including the USA as well as Europe and Australia. Collaborative tools make communication easy and give real-time project updates, wherever you are.

needs.q: When do you address specific needs?
needs.a: From the project’s outset. We adapt our services to give a tailored solution, so the solution meets your goals and specific requirements exactly.

benefits.q: What are the tangible benefits for clients?
benefits.a: Cost-efficient solutions from skilled resources in Vietnam, delivered on time, with measurable results that contribute directly to business growth and a higher ROI.

security.q: How do you ensure data security?
security.a: With an integrity mindset: honesty and transparency in all dealings, backed by ethical standards and responsible practices, protect client data. Security automation and continuous scanning add further protection.

centricity.a: Client centricity is a core value. Client satisfaction drives long-term success and builds sustainable partnerships that foster mutual growth and innovation.

feedback.q: How do clients share vision and feedback?
feedback.a: Through dedicated channels and frequent check-ins, as part of a partnership approach. We integrate your input throughout the project lifecycle, so the work stays aligned with your expectations and goals.

input.q: When do you integrate client input?
input.a: Continuously, throughout development. Agile methods let us adjust quickly and keep the work collaborative, so the final product matches your vision.

value.q: How do you measure and demonstrate value?
value.a: We track metrics for speed, quality, product impact, and team autonomy. This metric-driven approach keeps us transparent and accountable, and the tangible results it shows validate ROI.

trust.q: How does XionTech build client trust?
trust.a: Through openness and reliability. Our steady commitment to client success shows in consistent performance and ethical practices, carried by a “Get IT Done” attitude.
